Name: BEHAVIOR_PARAM_ST
Description: Registers hitboxes and bullets while also handling some special properties

Fields.Name: Behavior Variation ID
Fields.Description: For Npc's - References the behavioVariationId of the Npc in NpcParam, will only work for Npc's with the same behaviorVariationId. For Player - References behaviorVariationId on weapons, will only work with weapons that have the same behaviorVariationId.

Fields.Name: Behavior Judge ID
Fields.Description: Id used in animations to reference this behavior

Fields.Name: Reference Type
Fields.Description: Defines what param this behavior references
Determines whether or not this behavior will consume spirit emblems

Fields.Name: Reference ID
Fields.Description: References AtkParam, Bullet, or SpEffectParam depending upon the refType

Fields.Name: SFX Variation ID
Fields.Description: SFX used for multiplayer session actions

Fields.Name: Stamina Cost
Fields.Description: Amount of Posture consumed when this behavior is invoked

Fields.Name: Durability Cost
Fields.Description: Amount of Fp/Mp consumed when this behavior is invoked

Fields.Name: Category
Fields.Description: Unique properties attached to this behavior

Fields.Name: Hero Point Cost
Fields.Description: Amount of humanity consumed when this behavior is invoked
